“You have a messaging problem” - actually bestie, YOU have a fearmongering problem.  The amount of misleading articles that have been churned out of the Murdoch Machine to whip people into a frenzy over this housing budget has been so prolific that even Sunrise’s own reporters are unaware of what’s actually going on.
 
Working people aren’t letting the loud minority dictate how they feel about a budget that aims to correct something which has been spiralling out of control for decades. It’s time we reinvest in making things fair for all Australians, not just the few who got in early.

Dianne Lucas was faced with an impossible choice: should she do her job, or should she obey the law? 

Abusers have no right to access the confidential counselling notes of their victims. While this particular case happened in the ACT, the problem remains Australia-wide - and the NSW union movement is coming together with victim-survivors to fight for change. 

When it comes to sexual assault counselling notes, NSW needs to introduce absolute privilege. Victim-survivors deserve dignity, justice and safe access to support. Join the thousands of people calling for urgent change - sign the petition in the comments.

Working aussies can’t keep up with the constant, unfair escalation of interest and rent hikes - and meanwhile, professional landlords continue to reap the benefits of a tax system that prioritises house hoarding over home ownership.

We need to come together to fight for a fairer housing system; one which makes it easier to buy your first home than your tenth. 

Sign the petition in our bio and join the thousands of workers calling for urgent housing reform!

Thomas Costa, assistant secretary of Unions NSW, slams One Nation for being anti-worker in an explosive speech at the ALP state conference. 

“One Nation have never lifted a finger for a workers’ bargaining power. They’ve never won a pay rise. They’ve never closed a loophole. They’ve never backed a single measure to stop wage theft.”
 
The speech comes as the NSW union movement ramps up the fight for a Labour Hire Licensing scheme to protect workers from scam companies and dodgy employers that have already been banned in other states. Join the fight at the link in our bio and sign the petition to BAN SCAM COMPANIES FROM NSW.

Let’s stop normalising the level of interference that’s currently happening within our political system. 
A Current Affair, The ABC, The Guardian and The Sydney Morning Herald have found that Australians online are being influenced by an influx of foreign digital creators who monetise their content to push extremist ideology in support of One Nation. 

One group has 117,000 members, with all three administrators based in Indonesia pumping out dozens of posts daily in support of One Nation. Much of it is AI-generated. The majority of the commentors are genuine Australian accounts. This is an engagement-farm operation harvesting money from a real Australian audience. 

These accounts are loud. They are convincing. They are easy to fall for. 
We must be louder. 

Join us in the fight against Trump-style politics - go to the link in our bio to see how you can help.

If you have a boss, you have a union. 

But more than that - you have a movement that you can be part of. A movement that fights for you and your coworkers. 

Your union is more than just insurance against future bad bosses. It’s a network of union members fighting daily for stronger safety conditions, wage increases, and an Australia that puts workers first. Join the fight. Join your union. 

Find out which union you belong to at the link in our bio!
